incoming.name: Attila the Hun
incoming.excerpt: The name Attila could be of pre- Turkic ( Altaic) origin (compare it with Atatürk and Alma-Ata, now called Almaty).

incoming.name: Apple
incoming.excerpt: …region where it is thought to originate is called Alma-Ata, or "father of the apples".

outgoing.name: Soviet Union
outgoing.excerpt: On 21 December 1991, the Charter that ended the Soviet Union creating the Commonwealth of Independent States was signed there.
